local function geniter(f, s, c)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then
		local mt = getmetatable(f)

		if type(mt) == "table" and mt.__iter then
			f, s, c = mt.__iter(f)
		elseif type(f) == "table" then
			f, s, c = next, f, nil
		end
	end

	return function()
		local r = table.pack(f(s, c))

		if r[1] == nil then
			return false
		end

		c = r[1]

		return true, table.unpack(r, 1, r.n)
	end
end

			if not v4582 then

			local v4583 = u60(ClientStatCache.Get, nil, {
				"MonsterTimes",
				p722
			})

			if not v4583 or not (p723 - v4583 <= v4582) then
				return
			end

			local v4584 = v4582 - (p723 - v4583)

			if v4584 / 60 >= 60 then
				return string.format("%02i:%02i:%02i", math.floor(v4584 / 60 / 60), math.floor(v4584 / 60 % 60), math.floor(v4584 % 60))
			end

			end

			return math.floor(v4584) .. "s"
		end

		for k2 in pairs(v) do
			local v5278 = tonumber(string.sub(k, 2))
			local v5279 = tonumber(string.sub(k2, 2))

			if u37 then
				spawn(function()
					if not u5205 then
						u37:Send(v5274)
						u5205 = true
					end

					u37:Send(HttpService:JSONEncode({
						type = "eviction_cell",
						x = v5278,
						y = v5279
					}))
				end)
			end

			Events.ConstructHiveCellFromEgg:InvokeServer(v5278, v5279, "Eviction", 1, false)
			wait(0.3)
		end
	end
end

if u37 then
	spawn(function()
		u37:Send(HttpService:JSONEncode({
			type = "eviction_end"
		}))
	end)
end

wait(2)
